crossRefs.note: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the…
It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water…
You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach…
He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I give you.”
He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.
Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.
translations.bsb: And Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and all the signs He had commanded him to perform.
translations.kjv: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded
translations.asv: And Moses told Aaron all the words of Jehovah wherewith he had sent him, and all the signs wherewith he had charged him.
